text: AI is changing the workplace in many ways. One major change is automation, where machines and software do tasks that people used to do, such as sorting data or answering customer questions. There are also many productivity tools that help workers save time and focus on important tasks. Instead of replacing humans completely, AI often works together with people, and this is called human-AI collaboration. However, jobs are changing. Some roles may disappear, while new ones appear. This means workers need to learn new skills to stay successful in a modern, fast-moving work environment.
